title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, for approval by the Department of Public Utilties of the Company's annual performance program relating to fuel procurement and use. The performance program must be filed by each electric company having a fuel charge approved by the Department. The Company's annual performance program proposes efficiency goals for each generating unit owned or operated by the Company and for each generating unit from which the Company receives power under a specific unit contract.
